Part 1 必考 物品 OBJECTS

Home/Accommodation

家 / 住所

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What kind of house or apartment do you want to live in in the future?

In the future, I'd love to own a bigger apartment, maybe with an extra room for myself, since I currently share a room with my brother. Having my own space to use my computer freely sounds really appealing.

未来想住更大的房子，有自己的房间不跟弟弟挤，方便用电脑。

Q2Are the transport facilities to your home very good?

Actually, yes, they're quite convenient. There's a bus stop right outside my community, and the metro station is within walking distance, so I can reach most of Shenzhen without much trouble.

交通很方便，小区门口有公交站，地铁站走路就到。

Q3Do you prefer living in a house or an apartment?

Well, I'd say an apartment, since that's what I've grown up with. A house with a garden sounds nice in theory, but an apartment in the city is far more practical.

更喜欢公寓，从小住习惯了，城市里公寓更实用。

Q4Please describe the room you live in.

My room isn't very big, but it's pretty cosy. I share it with my younger brother in a bunk bed, and there's a desk near the window where I work on my computer. It gets a bit crowded sometimes, to be honest.

房间不大但温馨，和弟弟睡上下床，窗边有桌子用电脑。

Q5What part of your home do you like the most?

Honestly, I like my own room the most, even though it's shared. That's where my desk and computer are, so it's basically my little world where I spend most of my time.

最喜欢自己的房间，因为桌子电脑都在那儿，基本是我的小天地。

Q6How long have you lived there?

I've been living in this apartment for as long as I can remember, basically my whole life. We moved here when I was quite young, so this place holds a lot of memories for me and my family.

从小就住这儿，基本住了一辈子，满满回忆。

Q7Do you plan to live there for a long time?

Probably, yeah. It's close to everything, and the neighborhood is quiet, which I really appreciate. Since I'd like to stay in Shenzhen after graduation, I imagine I'll be here for quite a while yet.

应该会住很久，小区安静交通方便，毕业后也想留在深圳。

Q8What's the difference between where you are living now and where you have lived in the past?

To be honest, I've basically lived in this same neighborhood my whole life, so there's no big difference for me. I suppose the area has grown busier over the years, with more buildings going up, but our apartment itself hasn't changed much.

基本一直住这个小区，区别不大，就是周边新盖了些楼。

Q9Can you describe the place where you live?

I live in an apartment, you know, a three-bedroom one with my family in Shenzhen. My brother and I actually share a room with a bunk bed, which is pretty fun. There's a desk where I sit and use my computer most of the day.

深圳三室一厅，跟弟弟睡上下床，桌边整天用电脑。

Q10What room does your family spend most of the time in?

Probably the living room, since that's where we all gather to eat dinner and watch TV together. My grandfather likes to sit there in the afternoon, and my parents often chat there after work. It's the heart of our home, really.

客厅，全家一起吃饭看电视，爷爷也爱待那儿。

Q11What's your favorite room in your apartment/house?

My favorite room has to be my bedroom, no question. I mean, that's where my computer is, and I spend hours there studying and gaming with my brother. The bunk bed makes it feel like a little den for the two of us.

最喜欢卧室，电脑在那儿，和弟弟一起学习打游戏，上下床像小窝。

Q12What makes you feel pleasant in your home?

I think what really makes me feel good is the quiet environment. The neighborhood is peaceful, so I can focus on my computer without distractions. Also, having my whole family around makes the place feel warm and lively, which I really value.

小区安静能专心用电脑，加上家人在身边很温暖。

Q13Do you think it is important to live in a comfortable environment?

Definitely, I think it matters a lot. A comfortable home helps you relax and recharge after a stressful day, and it also affects your mood and even your health. For me, a quiet place to study and rest is essential.

非常重要，舒适的家能放松充电，安静的环境对学习休息很关键。

Q14Do you live in an apartment or a house?

I live in an apartment, specifically a three-bedroom one that my parents bought. It's our family home, where I've lived with my parents, my grandfather and my siblings for as long as I can remember.

住的是父母买的三室一厅公寓，一家几代人一起住。

Q15Who do you live with?

I live with my parents, my grandfather and my siblings, so our family is quite large. With five of us or more under one roof, the apartment always feels busy, but I actually enjoy having everyone around.

和爸妈、爷爷、兄弟姐妹一起住，一家五口以上很热闹。

Q16What do you usually do in your apartment?

Most of my time at home goes to my computer, to be honest. I study, browse videos, chat with friends, and sometimes play games, all at my desk in my room. I don't really go out much, so that's my daily routine.

在家基本就是对着电脑，学习、刷视频、聊天打游戏都在书桌前。

Q17What kinds of accommodation do you live in?

It's a standard apartment block, and our unit is a three-bedroom one, so I guess you could call it typical urban accommodation. Nothing fancy, but it's comfortable enough for our whole family.

普通小区三室一厅，标准城市住宅，不算豪华但住得舒服。
